Keep the file local, import it, then delete the export when you are done.Choose 1Password CSVChoose 1PUXBitwardenImport a user-exported Bitwarden CSV or JSON file.Accepted: Bitwarden CSV or JSONBitwarden web app: select Tools, select Export, choose My vault or an organization in Export from, choose .csv or .json as File Format, select Export, then confirm with your master password or email verification code.Bitwarden browser extension: open Settings, choose Vault options, choose Export vault, choose My vault or an organization, choose .csv or .json, select Export vault, then confirm.Maho accepts plaintext individual CSV, organization CSV, and plaintext JSON. Encrypted JSON and ZIP-with-attachments exports are not accepted here.Exported password files are plaintext.
